body:
Source: GitHub issue #833 (release-audit class trust-boundary, P1-high, security). Re-verified on main @ e2bc60ab: `plugins/adlc-herdr/bin/action.mjs` (around line 37) computes `pluginRoot: process.env.HERDR_PLUGIN_ROOT ?? '.'` and passes it to `planAction`, which (in `plugins/adlc-herdr/lib/actions.mjs`, around line 72-78, the `ticket-show` case) uses it to build a spawn argv: `'node', \`${pluginRoot}/bin/show-ticket.mjs\`, repoRoot, active.id`. Checked the actual manifest `plugins/adlc-herdr/herdr-plugin.toml`: it declares every action's command as `["node", "bin/action.mjs"]` with NO env configuration anywhere in the file — `HERDR_PLUGIN_ROOT` is never set by the host in normal operation, so the `'.'` fallback is not a rare edge case, it is the ALWAYS-ACTIVE path. `'.'` resolves relative to the process's CWD, which `plugins/adlc-herdr/lib/repo-root.mjs` (a sibling file in this same plugin) shows is set to the INSPECTED REPO's directory (`cwd: repoRoot` is passed for the `gate`/`prosecute` spawns in the same file) — meaning `bin/show-ticket.mjs` is resolved and executed from the TARGET repository being inspected, not from the plugin's own installation. A repository can ship a file at that exact relative path and have it executed by the herdr host process.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `plugins/adlc-herdr`: bin/{action,board,on-event,show-ticket,watcher}.mjs, lib/{actions,adlc-state,board-nav,board-render,display-width,event-plan,fleet-bridge,herdr,manifest,nudge,panemap,repo-root,sanitize,tokens,watch-plan}.mjs. The plugin's OWN test files already use the correct pattern for resolving the plugin's real installed location: `plugins/adlc-herdr/test/manifest.test.mjs:15` and `test/actions-phase2.test.mjs:13` both do `const pluginRoot = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..')` (or `join(...)` — same idea) relative to the TEST file's own `import.meta.url`, which is stable and unspoofable regardless of CWD. Tests: `node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/*.test.mjs` (root runner segment `herdr`).

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `plugins/adlc-herdr/bin/action.mjs`, derive `pluginRoot` from `action.mjs`'s OWN `import.meta.url` — `resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..')` (bin/ is one level under the plugin root, same as the test files' pattern) — NEVER from `process.env.HERDR_PLUGIN_ROOT` and never from a CWD-relative default. Remove the `HERDR_PLUGIN_ROOT ?? '.'` expression entirely; there is no legitimate reason to accept an externally-supplied override for a value that must always point at the plugin's own trusted installation.
2. `planAction` in `lib/actions.mjs` keeps accepting `opts.pluginRoot` as a parameter (tests already construct it directly, e.g. `{ pluginRoot: '/plug' }` in `test/action.test.mjs` and `test/actions-phase2.test.mjs`) — do not change that function's signature or its existing tests; only change WHERE `action.mjs` gets the value it passes in.
3. Every other `bin/*.mjs` entrypoint in this plugin that might need its own plugin-root-relative path (grep for any other `process.env.HERDR_PLUGIN_ROOT` or bare `'.'`-relative spawn target) gets the SAME fix if found — but do not go looking for unrelated issues outside this specific vulnerability class.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `action.mjs`'s resolved `pluginRoot` (asserted via an exported helper or by inspecting the constructed `planAction` call, whichever is cleaner given the existing module structure) equals the plugin's real installed directory regardless of `process.cwd()` or any `HERDR_PLUGIN_ROOT` env value — run with `process.cwd()` pointed at a throwaway temp directory AND with `HERDR_PLUGIN_ROOT` set to an attacker-controlled path, both must be ignored. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/plugin-root-resolution.test.mjs`
- AC2 The `ticket-show` action's constructed spawn argv (`planAction('ticket-show', ...)`'s `herdrArgs`) points at `<real-plugin-root>/bin/show-ticket.mjs`, never at a path constructed from cwd or env. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/plugin-root-resolution.test.mjs`
- AC3 `grep -c "HERDR_PLUGIN_ROOT" plugins/adlc-herdr/bin/action.mjs` is 0 after the fix (the env var is fully removed, not merely deprioritized). verify: `grep -c "HERDR_PLUGIN_ROOT" plugins/adlc-herdr/bin/action.mjs` (expect 0)
- AC4 Existing suite green — `test/action.test.mjs` and `test/actions-phase2.test.mjs` still pass unmodified (they construct `opts.pluginRoot` directly and never touch `action.mjs`'s own resolution, per item 2). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC5 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: any change to `lib/actions.mjs`'s `planAction` signature or its existing tests; the `gate`/`prosecute` actions' `cwd: repoRoot` (correct as-is — those intentionally run IN the inspected repo, unlike the plugin-relative `show-ticket.mjs` spawn).

PROCESS (ADLC). Work only in your assigned worktree. P3: the rails on this ticket are frozen — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, STOP and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. P4: TDD — write test/plugin-root-resolution.test.mjs first, run it RED, then implement. P5 before opening the PR: the package suite, `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` (exit 0), then the cross-model review loop (see lane instructions) until a round is clean. Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to plugins/adlc-herdr/bin/action.mjs, its new test, and this ticket's shard. PR title `fix(adlc-herdr): ...`, body must contain `Closes #833`.
title: plugin(adlc-herdr): resolve pluginRoot from the plugin's own installed location, never HERDR_PLUGIN_ROOT or a cwd-relative fallback
